title: Insurance Claim Services Credited-Line Write-Off: Carrier Pricing of Water Job Credits
content:
**Rule.** In the Insurance Claim Services credited-line write-off, the carrier's pricing for water job lines is applied as follows: on a Carrier Program Claim Billing file, the water job credit families less the tier's program pricing discount, because the approved estimate was priced net of it; on any other file whose estimate carried at least the tier's minimum number of distinct trades and was submitted on or after the water job was opened, so that it carried the water job's mitigation lines, the water job credit families raised by the tier's overhead percentage plus profit percentage, because the approved estimate added overhead and profit to its whole line-item total; otherwise the water job credit families stand.

"Less the discount" multiplies the water job credit families together by one less the discount percentage; "raised by overhead plus profit" multiplies them by one plus the sum of the two percentages. The water job is the Water Damage Mitigation job; its opened date is compared with the claim file's estimate submission date, and the trade count is the estimate's number of distinct trades.

## Tier figures the rule uses

| Arrangement | Program pricing discount % | Overhead % | Profit % | Minimum distinct trades |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support | 0 | 10 | 10 | 3 |
| Direction to Pay Claim Billing | 0 | 10 | 10 | 3 |
| Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing | 0 | 10 | 10 | 3 |
| Carrier Program Claim Billing | 6.5 | 0 | 0 | 99 |
| Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing | 0 | 10 | 10 | 3 |
| Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration | 0 | 10 | 10 | 3 |

## Hypothetical figures

- Carrier Program Claim Billing, water job credit families of 300.00: 300.00 multiplied by 0.935 is 280.50.
- Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing, estimate with 4 trades submitted after the water job opened: 300.00 multiplied by 1.20 is 360.00.
- The same file with an estimate of 2 trades: the credit families stand at 300.00.
